dedupe_keys.name: documentation for modelling wind farm effects in harmonie arome

description: Jana Fischereit and colleagues publish wind-farm inputs, WRF configuration files and analysis scripts for evaluating wind-farm effects in HARMONIE–AROME cycle 43.2.2. The February 2024 archive is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The Geoscientific Model Development paper explicitly identifies this deposit and compares wake parameterisations against aircraft measurements and WRF simulations for European offshore cases, including 2017 events. These materials can help reproduce the study’s weather and wind-energy simulations. The full HARMONIE model requires separate consortium access, and its code modifications are in the journal supplement, not established as part of this archive. Observations and forcing also have separate repositories. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment package. Parameterisation bias and unavailable vertical wake observations limit validation. Internal completeness and computational results were not independently checked.
